title: Purair® RX Ductless Balance Enclosures
meta_title: Purair RX Ductless Balance Enclosures - Protect Operators from Powder and Particle Hazards
meta_description: The Purair® RX Balance Hood is a Class I enclosure that meets USP 800 requirements for non-sterile compounding procedures. Featuring high efficiency EC blowers, energy-saving LED lighting, and improved filter clamping.
meta_keywords: purair rx, ductless balance enclosures, powder containment, particle hazards, usp 800, non-sterile compounding
short_description: The Purair® RX Balance Hood is a Class I enclosure that meets USP 800 requirements for non-sterile compounding procedures.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair RX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Features include high efficiency ebm-papst EC blowers, energy savings LED lighting, and improved filter clamping to eliminate bypass leakage. The exhaust canopy allows for thimble ducting to the facility exhaust system, and a filter blockage alarm ensures proper operation. The Purair RX is compliant with USP 800 and USP 795 guidelines, protecting operators from powder and particle hazards.
seo_content: The Purair RX ductless balance enclosure is designed to provide a safe, controlled environment for a variety of laboratory and industrial applications, including balance enclosures, compounding, powder mixing, and powder weighing. Its innovative filtration technology and comprehensive safety features make it a top choice for facilities that need to comply with USP 800 and USP 795 guidelines.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CRF, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
